topPRs.title: Add WAKU token to Base
topPRs.author: antoine-wak
topPRs.body:
**Description**

Add WAKU (Wakweli) to the token list for Ethereum and Base.

- Ethereum: `0x93F014930d90A0D0f17B079f71D9aA5f3ADf2b27`
- Base: `0x4d6B62861D1F60e864fD7C913f840d70b2713D0c`

The pair is already live on the native OP Standard Bridge: 5,960,018.25 WAKU qre
held on Base, matching the amount escrowed in the L1StandardBridge to the wei, and
the bridge's `deposits[l1][l2]` accounting agrees. This PR only adds the metadata so
the token is selectable in Superchain bridge front-ends.

The Base token is an `OptimismMintableERC20` on the standard L2 bridge
(`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000010`), with `l1Token()` and `remoteToken()`
both returning the Ethereum address above. Both contracts are verified.

**Tests**

`pnpm validate --datadir ./data --tokens WAKU` passes with no errors and no warnings.

**Additional context**

`logo.svg` is 256x256 and pure vector: one `<circle>` and one `<path>`, with no
embedded raster image, no text elements and no external references.

**Metadata**

N/A

topPRs.title: Add wRATR (Wrapped Ratatoskr) on Base
topPRs.author: NexusAther
topPRs.body:
Adds **Wrapped Ratatoskr (wRATR)** — a Base ERC-20 at `0xDeb6265cEE49CC277A938452DEDAb2B8774210d1` (source-verified on BaseScan).

wRATR is minted 1:1 against native RATR held in a public reserve via the Ratatoskr↔Base bridge. It is a custodial wrapper and is **not** deployed via the OP StandardTokenFactory / standard bridge, so `nobridge: true` is set (it is not intended for the Optimism Bridge app).

- `name` / `symbol` / `decimals` match on-chain (`Wrapped Ratatoskr` / `wRATR` / `8`)
- Base-only entry (no L1 token)
- Standard ERC-20 — no fee-on-transfer or rebasing

Website: https://ratatoskr.enchantedforestdefi.com
